{{Top}}
{{Quote|&hellip;we'll have a couple of surprises for him.|Jango Fett|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
[[File:SeismicCharge-SWX.png|thumb|right|250px|Krupx Munitions Void-7 seismic charge.]]
A '''seismic charge''' (also '''sonic mine''' or '''sonic charge''') was a weapon released from a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], capable of unleashing a devastatingly explosive shock wave. Seismic charges were commonly filled with a mix of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] and volatile [[collapsium]] gas.

==Description==
{{Listen|filename=Seismic charge.flac|title=SeismicCharge.flac|description=An exploding Void-7 seismic charge}}
[[File:SeismicCharge.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A seismic charge detonating.]]
A few seconds after launch, a seismic charge would detonate into a blue ball-shaped explosion which had the unusual side-effect of drawing in all sound from a given area around it. This small explosion soon collapsed in upon itself before releasing a shock wave of energy that would obliterate material in its path. They were particularly effective in [[asteroid field]]s, enabling the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to clear an area of hazardous [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="Episode 2" /> Such seismic waves were even capable of penetrating thin [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] plating, such as the [[Void-7 seismic charge/Legends|Void-7 seismic charge]] produced by [[Krupx Munitions/Legends|Krupx Munitions]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|310|Void-7}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The sound from an explosion of this weapon is an interesting take on the Star Wars "ignorance" of the fact that there is no sound in a vacuum. There is no sound at the start of a blast, but there is still the impossible phenomenon of sound in space afterward. The idea during the production of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|Episode II]] was that the charge would suck in and absorb all the sound around it (such as the sounds of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] ships during their fight in the [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] asteroid belt), and then release them in a sonic explosion, resulting in the shockwave effect heard in the explosion sound.

In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[time bomb]]s bear a strong resemblance to Krupx Munitions Void-7 seismic charges.
